reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, post-fix stale re-review batch 1, 2026-08-02

samples_reviewed.question_text: The total is 75 and one part is 1. What is the other part?
The dot is at 36 and it moves backward 10 numbers. Starting from 36, just count back 10 numbers. Which number will the dot land on?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Both named digit combinations appear -- 2-digit minus 1-digit in "What is 19 − 0?" (42) and "What is 11 − 1?" (43), 2-digit minus 2-digit in "60 − 20 = ___" (44) -- but the competency requires these be solved 'using concrete and pictorial models,' and 7 of 9 samples are bare symbolic equations with no visual or concrete representation at all.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Both digit-pairing sub-cases the competency names are represented, e.g. 2-digit minus 1-digit in "Dante says: 21 − 1 = 20. Is Dante correct?" (82) and 2-digit minus 2-digit in "40 − 20 = ___" (45) and "14 − 10 = ___" (46), and no sample requires regrouping.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Sentence forms stay short and direct, e.g. "60 − 20 = ___" and the count-back narration in seed 51 ("Starting from 36, just count back 10 numbers"), matching Grade 1 Q3 reading and reasoning demand.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Only seed 51's number-line count-back ("The dot is at 36 and it moves backward 10 numbers... Which number will the dot land on?") and seed 50's part-whole framing ("The total is 75 and one part is 1. What is the other part?") offer any concrete/pictorial or alternate framing; the remaining seven samples are all bare '# − # = ___' or 'What is # − #?' equations.

competency_alignment.rationale: Every sample, including the number-line count-back and the part-whole framing, still tests subtracting a smaller number from a larger one without regrouping, so the variation stays on this competency's core skill rather than drifting to an unrelated axis.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Values used (0 to 75) stay comfortably under the competency's stated less-than-100 ceiling, e.g. "The total is 75 and one part is 1. What is the other part?", and no subtraction in the packet ever requires borrowing across a ten.
